name: Husqvarna HTC 950 RX
summary: Remote-controlled planetary floor grinder with four grinding discs and a 920 mm grinding width for large concrete floor areas, with water-mist tool cooling and battery power for loading moves.

notes: Remote-controlled, not autonomous: the operator drives the machine by remote control.
Mains-powered for grinding (3-phase); battery power for moves when loading and unloading.

Integrated Mist Cooler system, floating shroud against dust spread and for grinding closer to edges, multi-step built-in weight system for grinding pressure. Recommended extractors HTC D80 or T 10000.
